hints.voice: If source/ is missing: cp -r {SKILL}/assets/template source && (cd source && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run vendor). Then: python3 {S}/voice.py --project . --emit source/timing.js
hints.visuals: Write the film in source/scenes.js (kit: source/kit/, look: source/tokens.js, guide: {SKILL}/references/gsap-guide.md). Lint until 'ok': node {S}/gsap_check.mjs --page source/index.html . Stills: node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --prime 0.25 --stills chapters --timing timing.json --stills-dir stills && node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --prime 0.25 --stills lines --timing timing.json --stills-dir stills . Open every still with Read, fix, re-shoot. Check text size and contrast: python3 {S}/legibility.py --project . (fix every red box in stills/legibility/, re-shoot, re-run), then: python3 {S}/vstate.py attest visuals "<what you checked and fixed>"
hints.render: node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --prime 0.25 --bench 3   (fps + ETA), then in the background: mkdir -p build && node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --out build/silent.mp4 --prime 0.25 --workers 4 --max-minutes 100 > build/render.log 2>&1  (use --workers 2 --segment 10 on a shared machine). Poll: tail -n 3 build/render.log. Exit 3 = budget reached: run the same command again (finished segments are kept) until the log says 'wrote'. Then: python3 {S}/vstate.py advance
